summary.oneLiner: ASM Technologies is an AI-powered Design-Led Manufacturing (DLM) enterprise providing custom capital equipment and end-to-end engineering-to-manufacturing solutions for the Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Engineering, Aerospace and Medical industries.
summary.business: ASM Technologies integrates product engineering, electronics, embedded systems, software and manufacturing capabilities to help customers move from concept design to scalable manufacturing and lifecycle support. It serves high-growth, advanced industries including Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Engineering, Aerospace and Medical through offerings spanning concept design, product engineering, system integration, prototyping, validation and manufacturing, delivered through offshore development/support centers in India and overseas and a global manufacturing network of seven facilities.

Design-Led Manufacturing: Custom capital equipment and technology solutions for semiconductor, electronics, solar, aerospace and medical industries

risks.risk: Competition risk from rapid technological shift
risks.note: Industries are highly competitive and shifting from traditional engineering models towards AI, Industrial AI, automation and intelligent manufacturing, requiring continuous investment in capabilities and offerings to sustain competitiveness.

A portion of the Company's revenues is generated from international markets, so foreign exchange volatility may impact financial performance; the Company relies on receivable management, cost discipline and FX hedging policies to mitigate this.
Talent availability and retention of skilled professionals remain important given the evolving technology landscape and increasing demand for specialised skills.

Rapid advancements in AI, Industrial AI, automation and intelligent manufacturing are continuously transforming traditional business models, requiring continued investment in technology and innovation to avoid obsolescence.

The Company operates in a global business environment exposed to geopolitical developments, trade restrictions, changing regulatory environments and economic slowdowns across geographies, which may affect customer spending patterns, supply chains and business sentiment; mitigated partly through diversified geographic presence and offshore delivery/manufacturing model.

Increasing adoption of digital technologies, automation and AI-driven solutions across operations requires strong governance frameworks to address data security, system reliability and ethical-use concerns.
The Company is exposed to supply chain disruptions amid a dynamic business environment and evolving regulatory requirements, alongside rising competitive intensity.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: ASM Technologies is an AI-powered Design-Led Manufacturing (DLM) enterprise providing custom capital equipment and end-to-end engineering-to-manufacturing solutions for the Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Engineering, Aerospace and Medical industries.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: ASM Technologies integrates product engineering, electronics, embedded systems, software and manufacturing capabilities to help customers move from concept design to scalable manufacturing and lifecycle support. It serves high-growth, advanced industries including Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Engineering, Aerospace and Medical through offerings spanning concept design, product engineering, system integration, prototyping, validation and manufacturing, delivered through offshore development/support centers in India and overseas and a global manufacturing network of seven facilities.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: The company's revenue is driven by engineering design and electronic manufacturing services, with a strong client base across industries such as semiconductor equipment, network devices, and automotive.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:

- **Engineering Services:** Product engineering & design, System integration, prototyping and validation

guidance.title: Guidance / outlook
guidance.body: The company expects steady growth in revenue over the medium term, driven by an increase in business across segments.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: The company has growth options in the form of increasing its share of design-led manufacturing business and expanding its presence in new geographies.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Global semiconductor industry recorded annual sales of approximately USD 792 billion in 2025 and is expected to continue growing, driven by AI, high-performance computing and connected technologies
- Growing investments in Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Aerospace, Medical and Engineering sectors are expected to create new avenues for business growth
- Government initiatives promoting electronics and semiconductor manufacturing, localised manufacturing and supply chain diversification are strengthening the opportunity landscape
- Increasing adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Industrial AI and connected technologies is expected to accelerate demand for advanced engineering and manufacturing solutions
- India's auto component industry aims to reach approximately $145 billion in turnover by 2030 (per ACMA), supported by increasing localisation, exports and transition to electric mobility — a driver for the RV Forms & Gears business
- Aerospace sector witnessing strong momentum from increasing commercial aviation demand, defence modernisation programmes, localisation initiatives and growing participation by global aerospace OEMs
- Machine tool industry expected to benefit from sustained investments in manufacturing, automation and industrial modernisation supported by the 'Make in India' programme
- India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0 programme expected to provide significant impetus to domestic equipment manufacturing, benefiting the ASM HHV Engineering JV
- RV Forms & Gears: tractor engine, gearbox and transmission component programme at a leading Indian agricultural equipment manufacturer expected to continue in FY 2027
- RV Forms & Gears: active engagement with a leading American multinational (diesel/natural gas engines, EV components, power generation systems) with additional business planned for the coming financial year
- RV Forms & Gears: selected by a major global aerospace and aircraft engine manufacturer to develop and manufacture fixtures for global aerospace applications
- ASM HHV Engineering: repeat orders already received for intermediate storage and handling systems for silicon solar cell manufacturing; first production prototype undergoing final qualification testing and expected to be shipped shortly

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: The company's operating profitability is expected to sustain at around 19% over the medium term, driven by its ability to manage costs and improve operational efficiency.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: The company's financial risk profile is expected to remain comfortable, with a healthy networth and capital structure, and gradual repayment of term loans.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: During FY26, ASM Technologies expanded its manufacturing footprint by commissioning three new facilities — two in Bengaluru and one in Vietnam — taking the total to seven manufacturing facilities in operation as an integrated global manufacturing network. The Company is progressing long-term infrastructure expansion through the proposed development of a new integrated manufacturing facility in Karnataka, supported by land allotted through KIADB (approximately 10 acres). Separately, the Company received approval under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) for the manufacture of high-precision capital equipment, involving a proposed investment of ₹565 crore, with an approved government incentive of 25% of eligible project cost (approximately ₹141 crore).

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Over three decades of engineering design-led manufacturing expertise across capital equipment for high-growth industries
- AI Assist foundational intelligence layer and Industrial AI capabilities (Vision AI, Predictive AI, Engineering AI, Conversational AI) embedded across the DLM value chain and internal operations
- Global manufacturing network of seven facilities across India and Vietnam, providing capacity, flexibility and responsiveness to customer requirements
- Diversified geographic presence and strong offshore delivery/manufacturing model reducing dependency on any single geography or sector
- Strategic technology partnerships/investments — 20% stake in Myelin Foundry (Industrial AI) and 51% investment in Asmaitha Wireless Technologies (embedded systems, firmware, wireless technologies)

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: The company faces risks such as a large working capital cycle, susceptibility to employee attrition, and vulnerability to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: The company's extensive experience in the engineering design-led manufacturing and product development industry, and its diversified service offerings, are key strengths that support its growth prospects.
